technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the YARN info command as an extension of the existing xd-yarn command-line script and reuse the current ZooKeeper service-discovery data rather than introducing a new registry.

Implement the Reactor stream processor as a standard Spring XD module/plugin with the processor class as the minimum required configuration and expose additional settings through established module option metadata and command conventions.
Implement history tracking as an opt-in feature that enriches message headers with stream, module, and related execution identity while preserving existing message payloads and default behavior.

Implement Protocol Buffers through the existing codec/serialization abstraction using the official Java Protocol Buffers runtime and support generated message types rather than defining a proprietary schema format.
Implement complex-object performance coverage as repeatable automated tests and benchmarks covering nested objects, tree-shaped objects, and Protocol Buffer messages.

Implement the Ambari integration as an Ambari service/plugin definition with install, configure, start, stop, status, and monitoring integration using Spring XD's existing cluster-management and configuration mechanisms.

Document the JDBC HDFS partition rules in the wiki and implement validation so partitioned jobs require tableName and columns when partitionColumn is used, while sql and tableName remain mutually exclusive.
Preserve backward compatibility by keeping new options disabled or non-invasive unless explicitly selected and by retaining existing non-partitioned JDBC behavior.
assumptions: The estimate covers implementation, unit and integration testing, documentation, code review preparation, and local verification for all eight user stories.

An existing Spring XD source tree, build, command-line framework, module/plugin framework, message-header model, codec abstraction, and JDBC HDFS option metadata implementation are available and can be extended.
The existing project Java and dependency baseline is used; upgrading the entire product to Java 17 or Spring Framework 6 is out of scope.
A usable ZooKeeper test instance or test harness is available for the YARN info command, but a full production YARN cluster is not required for the estimate.
The Reactor implementation targets a supported Reactor version already compatible with the project; extensive changes to the project-wide reactive programming model are out of scope.
Protocol Buffer schemas and generated message classes are supplied by users or test fixtures; this increment does not include designing a schema registry or generating schemas dynamically.
The Ambari work targets a conventional Ambari service definition and management scripts for a supported Ambari release; support for every Ambari and Hadoop distribution is out of scope.
Performance testing is implemented as automated representative benchmarks rather than a full-scale production capacity study.
Wiki and command/module documentation can be updated in the existing documentation system without creating a new publishing pipeline.
Effort is expressed in work-hours for one developer and excludes elapsed waiting time for external reviews, infrastructure provisioning, and release approval.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing command-line, module, messaging, codec, JDBC HDFS, test, build, and deployment structures; map each user story to extension points; define acceptance criteria and implementation sequencing.

Add the xd-yarn info command, query the current deployment through ZooKeeper, extract the admin port and other useful connection information, format the result for users, handle missing or invalid deployment data, and add command and integration tests.

Design and implement the Reactor processor module/plugin, support the minimum processor-class configuration, add module metadata and lifecycle wiring, investigate and implement well-known module option commands for additional configuration, and add unit and end-to-end module tests.

Define the history header fields and propagation behavior, add configuration for enabling tracking, enrich messages with stream and module identity without changing payloads, cover producer and consumer paths, and add compatibility and integration tests.

Integrate the Protocol Buffers Java runtime with the existing codec abstraction, implement serialization and deserialization for generated message types, expose codec selection/configuration, handle invalid data and type errors, and add round-trip and integration tests.

Create representative nested, tree-shaped, and Protocol Buffer test objects; add automated serialization and stream-processing coverage; measure representative throughput and payload behavior; and document the test methodology and results.

Implement the Ambari service/plugin definition, package and configuration descriptors, install and configuration handling, start/stop/restart/status operations, service-user and directory setup, monitoring/status reporting, and validation against a representative Ambari-managed cluster or test harness.

Update the wiki and user-facing job documentation to explain partitionColumn behavior, the required tableName and columns combination, the sql/tableName mutual exclusion rule, and examples based on JdbcHdfsOptionsMetadata validation.

Implement or complete validation and execution paths for partitioned jobs using either sql with a where clause or tableName with an explicit columns list, enforce mutually exclusive options, preserve non-partitioned behavior, and add metadata, validation, and integration tests.

Run the complete build and test suite, add missing regression cases, verify interactions with existing module options, headers, codecs, deployment commands, and JDBC jobs, diagnose failures, and perform compatibility cleanup.

activities.activity_name: Final technical documentation and delivery preparation
activities.activity_description: Complete configuration reference updates, usage examples, release notes, migration/backward-compatibility notes, test evidence, packaging checks, and final source/build cleanup for delivery.

activities.activity_name: Code review remediation and final verification
activities.activity_description: Perform a final implementation review, address likely review findings, verify dependency and licensing changes, rerun targeted and full tests, and prepare the increment for integration.
